title: Laziness & infinite lists
hints: README 'New syntax': infinite ranges, take/takeWhile/iterate, and lists that refer to themselves.

naturals: an open range from 0. firstSquaresOver: square the naturals, keep those > n, take 5. fibs: start with 0 : 1 :, then add the list to its own tail pairwise. primes: keep the first number, remove its multiples from the rest, repeat. collatz: iterate the step, stop before 1, then add [1].
`fibs = 0 : 1 : zipWith (+) fibs (tail fibs)` · `primes = sieve [2 ..] where sieve (p : xs) = p : sieve [x | x <- xs, mod x p /= 0]` · `collatz n = takeWhile (/= 1) (iterate step n) ++ [1]`.
